maintenance_led.reason: Revenue comes from consumer subscriptions and in-app purchases on Tinder, Hinge and other dating apps, not repair or servicing of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Paying users are consumers buying dating app subscriptions and features; no government payer.

serial_acquirer.reason: Growth comes mainly from Tinder and Hinge product and user growth; acquisitions of other dating brands are occasional.

mission_critical.reason: Consumers can easily switch or use multiple dating apps; they are not locked in, though they lose matches and profiles.
